clips.title: The story
paras: Deathstalker Rane Yorick sends word of Scourge resistance in Silverpine Forest to High Executor Hadrec.

Deathstalkers Rane Yorick and Quinn Yorick faced a deadly ambush in northern Silverpine Forest. Pinned down by Scourge in the pine woods, they gathered their findings into a hurried dispatch. It describes stronger resistance than the Forsaken expected as they seek to claim the region. Quinn was grievously injured, so Rane entrusted the report to passing allies, who must carry it to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher without delay.
